gen-dafont-quantum-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls, set beneath the rounded-rod display letters of Quantum. PT Sans Caption keeps paragraphs friendly and unhurried, its generous shapes carrying the eye along line after line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-puritan: Rounded and open to the side, Puritan reads friendly beneath the neon-tube letters of Quantum. And Puritan can be sized up a notch, since its oversized counters stay generous and clear at larger sizes.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-questrial: Flat, stencil-cut and tidy: Questrial draws its letters in a single weight. Next to Quantum, with its loose spacing and open mouths, the tall, short-stalked letters of Questrial feel like a close companion.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada stands its c, s and z tall and full, with clear curve endings, beneath Quantum. The plain sans can take a larger size without losing its shape.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and monoline strokes whose terminals end well away from the stem. Quantum is for showing off; Radio Canada Big is for carrying words.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-readex-pro: Loose letterfit with open mouths gives Quantum a spacious, tech-clean display look. And Readex Pro, with broad terminal gaps and a steady weight, does the quieter job of carrying words.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-roboto: Quantum has a marker-drawn plainness in every single character. Roboto, all generous round mouths, keeps paragraph after paragraph moving along smoothly, its capitals and lowercase sitting close in height.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-ruda: Quantum sets loose, tech-clean display letters with mouths that stay open and ascenders kept short. And Ruda brings a wire-like monoline body with a sizable x-height, so the page feels light from top to bottom.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-saira: Rounded letters that stretch high toward the top line, plus an s you can see through, give Saira its open feel. And Quantum does the announcing in tech-clean display shapes, while Saira does the steady talking.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-sarpanch: Every part of a letter carries the same visual mass in Quantum, loosely spaced and tech-clean. And Sarpanch, with a clearly open e and a compact gap to the ascenders, gives that display look an approachable partner.
